info.title: iso admin API
info.description: Create Firecracker microVMs, set their egress policy, and reach the agent inside them. Served on the daemon's unix socket (root only) and on its TCP listener, where a client certificate issued by the host's admin CA (`isoctl admin issue-client`) is required.

AddForwardRequest.description:
Open a new ingress forward. The host port is allocated by the control
plane and returned in the response.

BuildRequest.description: Ask for a template from an image.

force.description:
Rebuild even when a template of this name is already registered.
Without it, an existing template answers `ready` at once.

image.description:
The OCI image, as `isoctl bake --image` takes it: `python:3.12-slim`,
`ghcr.io/acme/tool:v3`, `registry/repo@sha256:…`.

log_tail.description: The last few KiB of the bake's output.

CreateVmRequest.description: Create and boot a VM. Only `template` is required.

allow.description: Domains routed through the egress proxy.

egress.description:
`proxy` or `deny` (default). Unrecognized values mean `deny`. There is
no direct mode: how much a VM may reach is its rules' business
(`allow https://*/**` opens everything, through the proxy).

id.description:
Create under this id (hyphenated UUID or 32 hex digits) instead of a
generated one. A fleet service records the id before it calls, so a
retry after a lost reply is a `409`, never a second VM.

ingress.description: Ports to forward into the VM; host ports are allocated.

labels.description: Free-form labels; `name` is surfaced to the guest's metadata.

mem_mib.description: Override the template's memory (forces a cold boot).

principal.description: Principal whose credentials the egress proxy injects.

rules.description:
URI-level rules, e.g. `allow https://api.github.com/**` or
`deny https://api.github.com/user/keys`. Deny wins; nothing matching
is denied. `allow` hosts are sugar for `allow https://host/**` plus
`allow wss://host/**`. A rule that does not parse is a 400.

vcpus.description: Override the template's vCPU count (forces a cold boot).

CreatedVm.description: The id of a newly created VM.

ErrorBody.description: The shape of every error response.

cmd.description: Program to run, resolved on the guest's `PATH`.

cwd.description: Working directory; default is the agent's.

env.description: Extra environment, layered over the agent's.

max_output_bytes.description: Cap on captured bytes per stream (default [`DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT`]).

stdin.description: Bytes written to the program's stdin before it is closed.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock limit; the process group is killed when it elapses.

user.description:
Run as this user, a name or a numeric uid, with that user's primary
group and `HOME`. Only an agent running as root can switch; any
other agent refuses a user that is not itself. Absent, the agent's
default user (the image's `USER` in a template built from an OCI
image, else the agent's own).

exit_code.description: The process exit code, or `None` if it was killed by a signal.

signal.description: Signal number that terminated the process, when there was one.

stderr.description: Captured stderr, lossily decoded as UTF-8.

stdout.description: Captured stdout, lossily decoded as UTF-8.

timed_out.description: The timeout elapsed and the process group was killed.

size.description: Total size of the file on disk.

PolicyRequest.description: Change a running VM's egress policy. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

egress.description: `proxy` or `deny`; anything else leaves the mode unchanged.

rules.description: Replace the URI-level rules. A rule that does not parse is a 400.

PortForward.description: An ingress port forward from a host port to a port inside the VM.

host_port.description: Allocated by the control plane; ignored on create, reported on read.

SignedPolicyDto.description:
A policy as a fleet signed it: base64 claims and an ed25519 signature
over those bytes. Opaque here.

filesystem_capacity_bytes.description: Filesystem containing the pool backing image, bytes.

pool_used_bytes.description: Estimated used data bytes, derived from LVM utilization.

snapshot_bytes.description: Allocated bytes of tracked VM suspension files, separate from thin-pool data.

Template.description: A registered template, as a placer needs to see it.

warm.description: Whether a memory snapshot exists, so clones resume rather than boot.

TemplateRequest.description: Register a template built by `isoctl bake`. Paths are host paths.

rootfs_template.description: The LVM template volume, without the `tpl_` prefix.

snapshot_mem.description: Memory snapshot; with `snapshot_vmstate`, VMs resume warm.

Vm.description: A VM as the control plane sees it.

rules.description: URI-level rules on top of `allow`, in `iso-policy` syntax.

slot.description: Placement slot; absent while a durable VM is stopped.

WriteFileRequest.description:
Write a file inside the guest: one of `content` (UTF-8 text) or
`content_b64` (arbitrary bytes).

mode.description: Permission bits to set, e.g. 493 for `0755`.
